paper_version: IEEE TVT 71(1), 2022, pp. 297-310; package journal PDF
state: ECEF position and independent per-observed-system receiver clocks in metres
input_role: corrected undifferenced raw pseudorange and raw-Doppler WLS velocity/covariance
velocity_output_role: finite difference of estimated positions, not an unconstrained graph variable
window: all supplied sequence history; offline future observations used
c_gm_source: journal PDF p. 7, Applied parameters; dimensionless whitened residual
weight_equation_source: stationary solution of Eqs. (19)-(21), Algorithm 1 Step 3; printed Eq. (22) omits square
final_theta_policy: clamp to one and alternate to convergence; final weights must affect state solve
numerical_parameter_source: fixed engineering convergence safeguards, common across all sequences; reaching a limit is failure
initialization: raw per-epoch pseudorange WLS; missing initial guesses propagated by raw Doppler inside anchored components
missingness: missing/invalid Doppler covariance removes its edge; no epoch removal or fallback output
rank_policy: reject component lacking 3D translation observability after eliminating epoch/system clocks; no added prior
